dev_refresh_connector_and_dataset_invent.session_rule_after_change: NAMED FOR COORDINATOR (not changed in this task): prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset (scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh:3113-3115) uses latest_published_broker_session (18:00 Taipei T), but check_taiwan_refresh_preflight (lines 2473-2491) and verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback (lines 1989-1996) still fall through to the 13:30 Taipei rule
dev_refresh_connector_and_dataset_invent.measured_publication_time_justification: FinMind TaiwanStockPER (tw_valuation_bwibbu) publishes after 18:00 Taipei on T; TaiwanStockMonthRevenue (tw_monthly_revenue) and TaiwanStockFinancialStatements/TaiwanStockBalanceSheet (tw_financial_statement) are periodic datasets whose normalized records stamp metadata.date with the period-end date (month-end or quarter-end) rather than the trading session date T, so 13:30 session-date equality in preflight/readback cannot match when FINMIND_API_TOKEN is configured

connectors_named_for_coordinator_on_1330.finding: While prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset (line 3115) uses latest_published_broker_session (18:00 Taipei) for is_finmind, preflight and readback only branch on connector_id == 'tw-finmind-broker-daily-report' or connector_id in CHIP_PUBLICATION_SCHEDULES, leaving the three FinMind fundamentals profiles on the 13:30 Taipei rule. In addition, dev host timer workflow_dispatch runs at 14:40 and 15:40 Taipei bypass the workflow schedule filter (github.event.schedule != '0 7 * * 1-5'), and tw_monthly_revenue / tw_financial_statement records carry period-end dates (month-end / quarter-end) in metadata.date rather than the trading session date.

Uses the 13:30 Taipei close rule on /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest. When the steady collector close pull has not yet covered a symbol and the bounded refresh falls back to direct OpenAPI fetch (TaiwanOfficialExchangeAdapter), TWSE OpenAPI STOCK_DAY_ALL (observed Last-Modified: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 21:20:45 GMT = 05:20:45 Taipei T+1) and TPEx OpenAPI tpex_mainboard_daily_close_quotes (observed Last-Modified: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:30:06 GMT = 23:30:06 Taipei T) publish later than 13:30 Taipei.

residual_findings.summary: The three FinMind fundamentals profiles (tw-finmind-monthly-revenue, tw-finmind-quarterly-statements, tw-finmind-valuation) use latest_published_broker_session (18:00 Taipei) in prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset but still fall through to the 13:30 Taipei session rule in check_taiwan_refresh_preflight and verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback (and monthly/quarterly records stamp metadata.date with month-end/quarter-end dates rather than the session date).

Legacy tests test_taifex_terminal_verifier_binds_requested_session_and_scope and test_chip_terminal_verifier_binds_dataset_schema_venue_run_and_source_session in scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py (outside the 5 scoped files for this task) still assert the pre-PR-#7592 13:30 Taipei rule for tw-taifex-futures-options-chip and TW_CHIP_REFRESH_PROFILES.
